newsitem.title: FINLAND: ISKO TO BUY MAJORITY IN ESTONIAN TIRE CO.
newsitem.headline: ISKO TO BUY MAJORITY IN ESTONIAN TIRE CO.

text.p: Finnish tire wholesaler and retailer Isko Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would acquire a majority in Estonian tire company A/S A-Rehvikeskus by subscribing to shares for five million kroons.
Isko would susbscribe to all shares in a directed issue and get 87 percent of the company's shares and votes. "Isko's investment will be five million Estonian kroons," it said.
The current owner Peeter Pahn would remain managing director of the company and hold a 13 percent stake in it, it said.
Rehvikeskus, which operates in Tarto and has been Isko's distributor in Estonia since 1995, was planning to open a full service tire house in Tallinn, Isko said.
